assertions.text: Repository development practice: SETUP.md is an instruction guide addressed to the coding agent for installing, locating a target file, running a first /reflect, and scheduling daily runs via launchd or cron.

Documented runtime constraints: sessions with fewer than 3 exchanges are not considered substantive, and the target file must be at least 100 bytes; skipped edits are logged with reasons such as ambiguous match or text not found.
The tool requires pi with an LLM API key configured; each run makes one LLM call, estimated at roughly $0.05–0.15 with Sonnet, and models are specified as provider/model-id strings.
jo-inc/pi-reflect is mentioned in this evidence.

Data sources support three types (files with glob patterns, shell commands capturing stdout, and HTTP URLs), all with {lookbackDays} interpolation and per-source maxBytes caps; file sources are date-pruned by filename.
The product exposes slash commands: /reflect (optionally with a file path), /reflect-config, /reflect-history, /reflect-stats, and /reflect-backfill.
Each run collects evidence from transcripts, daily logs, and reference files, sends evidence plus the target file and a prompt to an LLM, then applies the LLM's proposed edits with safety checks.

pi-reflect provides iterative self-improvement for pi coding agents: it reads recent conversations and reference material, compares actual behavior against a defined target, and edits the target file to close the gap.
The tool requires pi with an LLM API key configured; each run makes one LLM call, estimated at roughly $0.05–0.15 with Sonnet, and models are specified as provider/model-id strings.
Edit safety measures include backing up the original, skipping ambiguous matches, rejecting suspiciously large deletions, and auto-committing to git when the target is in a repository.

Configuration lives in ~/.pi/agent/reflect.json with a targets array; each target requires a path and model, and supports lookbackDays, maxSessionBytes, transcripts, transcriptSource, context, prompt, and backupDir fields.
Repository development practice: contributors clone the repo, run npm install and npm test (137 tests), and can test locally with pi -e ./extensions/index.ts without installing.

Targets are any markdown file, e.g. AGENTS.md for behavioral rules, MEMORY.md for long-term memory, or SOUL.md for personality; the prompt determines whether reflect strengthens rules, extracts durable facts, or sharpens identity.

/reflect-stats tracks reflection impact via a correction-rate trend (corrections per session over time) and rule recidivism (sections edited repeatedly); /reflect-backfill bootstraps stats from historical sessions in dry-run mode without editing files.
